## Notes

Developed by Anuke; created for the April 2017 itch.io Metal Monstrosity game jam; GPL-3.0; Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS; on Steam from 2019; v6 (2020) added RTS elements and logic blocks; v7 (2022) added Erekir; co-op, team PvP, free-for-all, and attack maps; 18 Serpulo and 10 Erekir turrets; 35 and 15 units.
